name: Gemma 2 9B
notes: PARAMS: 9.24B is the safetensors count (9B nominal). KV: 42 * 8 * 256 * 2 * 2 bytes = 344,064 bytes/token = 336 KiB/token, which is 2.6x the Llama 3.3 70B figure because head_dim is 256 rather than 128 and there are 42 rather than 80 layers. Gemma's wide-head GQA is expensive per token of context. SLIDING WINDOW: sliding_window=4096 on alternating local/global layers. Real resident KV at long context is therefore about half the naive figure, since local layers only keep 4096 tokens. LOGIT SOFTCAPPING is the numerically important part and it is NOT an attention change: attn_logit_softcapping=50.0 clamps the pre-softmax attention logits, and final_logit_softcapping=30.0 clamps the output logits, with query_pre_attn_scalar=256 scaling queries before the clamp. This changes the numerics of every attention and every sampling step, so it is not a drop-in for a plain Llama-shaped kernel, and it is why the model needed explicit stability work to train at 8k. SOURCE CAVEAT: unsloth mirror of Google weights.
